messages:
anya: Heads-up: plan to swap in quant-kernel v2.4 for the release-qa slice at 02:00 UTC tonight. Quiet window, low traffic bucket. Need final signoff and a short rollback plan.
sam: 👍 what are the smoke gates we care about? latency p50/p99, token errors, and OOMs right?
maya: yes. add model-compat regression (beam search diffs) and kv-cache integrity. I can run a quick diff on the top 10 prompts after deploy.
deploy-bot: Deploy requested by anya: environment=release-qa slice=nightly-qa kernel=quant-v2.4 strategy=staged(5%->50%->100%) window=02:00-04:00 UTC. ETA preflight checks: 12m.
anya: thanks. sam and lee please review the preflight checklist I posted in the release doc.
sam: looked. minor: we should pin the bundle signature hash in deploy config to avoid drift. I'll paste the hash once staging build finishes.
lee: I'll be oncall during the window. If p99 latency > 3s or error_rate > 0.5% for 5m, we rollback. Setting alert thresholds now.
ops-oncall: @lee noted. I'll keep the rollback playbook open and coordinate with infra to expedite pinning if needed.
maya: quick note: quant-v2.4 changes matmul kernel tiling; we saw a 0.8% perf variance on long seqs in perf lab. Should be fine for release-qa but calling it out.
any: (typo) meant "anya". also we should capture a small sample of token-level diffs for the prompt set pre/post to detect subtle regressions.
deploy-bot: Preflight result: staging smoke ok. latency delta p50: +0.02s, p99: +0.12s, no OOMs. bundle_hash=sha256:abc123... Ready to start.
sam: paste a one-liner rollback command please so ops can run quickly.
maya: rollback command:
```
deploy-bot rollback --env=release-qa --bundle=quant-v2.3 --reason="auto-rollback"
```
deploy-bot: Noted. Rollback playbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-quant
lee: I'll hold off on any manual drains unless deploy triggers alerts. If we see memory flaps, we'll pin traffic back to v2.3 and open an incident.
anya: final check: @sam are we good to proceed at 02:00?
sam: go for it. I'll be available for the first 30m to validate telemetry and approve the 50% hop.
ops-oncall: I'll be glued to the console. tagging owners for release notes: @maya will add kernel notes, @sam adds bundle pin details.
maya: putting a small blurb in release notes now: "quant-kernel v2.4: matmul tiling improvements, minor p99 regressed on long sequences; monitored in release-qa." :memo:
anya: thanks all. starting at 02:00 UTC. will post updates in this thread. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: stage=5% (slice=nightly-qa). watch: https://deploys.redwood.internal/7532109876
deploy-bot: Stage=5% complete. No alerts in 6m. progressing to 50%.
deploy-bot: Stage=50% complete. p99 latency +0.10s, error_rate 0.02%. advancing to 100%.
deploy-bot: Stage=100% complete. Post-deploy smoke ok. Capture: token-diff-sample=/artifacts/7532109876/diffs.txt
lee: validated token diffs, nothing concerning. closing handover to release team.
anya: excellent. rolling release notes and closing thread. If anything crops up, reply here and we'll pin traffic.
thread_summary: Coordination for deploybot-driven swap of quant-kernel v2.4 into release-qa: preflight checks, smoke gates, rollback command and thresholds, staged rollout notes, post-deploy validation and artifact links.
